execution.description: Ran the step 4 tests canonically, including a synthetic second Challenge with battery code made to raise.

expected: Stage and attack run for a second Challenge without battery code.
observed: 60 passed. The synthetic Challenge supplies only a Graphite record, an adapter, a pipeline construction block and a suite map; battery's adapter and experiment.admit raise if called, and nothing called them. At Level 4 its participant-code parts are IN_SCOPE and only Level 5 is NOT_RUN.
keep: A second-Challenge fixture that makes battery code raise is the test that the shared modules are neutral.
change: A real second Challenge needs its own Graphite record, adapter, suite map, committed coverage report and grant before its Attacker block.

proposed_revision.text: Before a Challenge's first Graphite campaign it supplies: its Graphite record (carbon/agent_campaign/graphite/challenges/<token>.json: pipeline family, label, coverage report, any vector wording, the Attacker campaign and its grant); its adapter (permission inventory, public identity, admission gate, code-run wall allowance, an out-of-contract recipe); its suite map; and a committed suite coverage report at its recorded construction level.
